Summary

  • A high-class, aggressive batter — strong vs short.
  • They get out most often to balls that are back of a length and on the stumps (6.7 dismissals/100).
  • Most often out caught in the field (30% of dismissals); most often to right fast (20).

Common themes

  • left-hand bat, averaging 39.2 at a strike rate of 86.8.
  • Carries a big share of the batting — 17.6% of team runs.
  • Scores mainly through the off side (35%).

Strengths

  • Main scoring shot is the drive (30% of runs).
  • The sweep brings them 18% of their runs — 2.5× the typical Test batter's share.
  • Handles both similarly (pace 39, spin 39).
  • Starts securely — their dismissal rate barely drops once set (2.2 early vs 2.2/100); early pressure alone won't buy their wicket. Early runs come mainly off the drive (30%).

Weaknesses / how to get him

  • Most often out caught in the field (30% of dismissals); most often to right fast (20).
  • Struggles on the stumps (27 avg, 2.9 outs/100).
  • The ball that swings away hurts them (avg 17 vs 38 when it holds its line).
  • Most dangerous ball: back of a length and on the stumps (6.7 dismissals/100, avg 20).
  • His cut is high-risk (false shot 41%, 2.0 outs/100).
